title: Uniqueness of Leray-Hopf weak solutions to the two-dimensional viscous Primitive Equations
summary: Global existence of Leray-Hopf (type) weak solutions to the viscous primitive equations in two or three dimensions was established by Lions--Temam--Wang \cite{Lions1,Lions2,Lions3,Lions4} in the 1990s; however, the corresponding uniqueness, no matter in two or three dimensions, has been a long standing open problem since then. In this paper, we solve this open problem in the two-dimensional case.
